onboarding.title: Tell us briefly
onboarding.lead: Four steps, under three minutes. Everything except your name and the two checkboxes is optional and can wait.
onboarding.basicsHint: Your name and language end up on your badge and in our emails.
onboarding.optionalHint: All optional — it helps us suggest the right things.
onboarding.interestsHint: Pick what interests you. It shapes what we suggest.
onboarding.consentHint: We need the first two to register you at all.
onboarding.photoHint: Photos and videos from the event that show you.
onboarding.newsletterHint: A few emails a year about the programme and deadlines.

profile.title: My profile

sections.channels: How did you hear about ChefTreff?

speaker.title: Speaker portal
speaker.lead: Everything for your appearance at the Future Leader Summit.
speaker.noProfileBody: There is no speaker profile for this edition yet. The speaker team creates it and invites you.
speaker.assistantBanner: You are working on behalf of {name}.
speaker.assistantConsentNote: Only the speaker can give consent or enter bank details.
speaker.allDone: All done — great to have you with us.
speaker.stepProfileBody: Name, job title and a short bio in English — that is what appears in the programme.
speaker.stepPhotoBody: The upload is being built. Until then, send us your photo at the speaker mailbox.
speaker.stepConsentsBody: We need photo/video and the speaker release before you appear in the programme.
speaker.stepSessionBody: Once your session is set, you submit title, description and slides here.
speaker.stepTicketBody: Your speaker ticket and the companion ticket appear here once they are issued.
speaker.supportBody: Write to the speaker team. We answer from a shared mailbox so someone always gets back to you.
speaker.profileLead: This is what appears in the programme and on the stage card.
speaker.fieldPronounsHint: Shown next to your name if you want.
speaker.fieldPhoneHint: For the team only, for the day itself.
speaker.fieldBioShortEnHint: Required. Two or three sentences for the programme.
speaker.consentPhotoVideo: Photo and video recordings during the event
speaker.consentSpeakerRelease: Name, bio and photo may be published in the programme
speaker.consentSlides: My slides may be shared after the summit
speaker.consentHospitality: My data may be used for hotel and shuttle
speaker.consentReadOnly: Only the speaker can decide this.
speaker.assistantLead: Your assistant can maintain profile, content and uploads — not consent or bank details.
speaker.assistantRemoveBody: Access ends immediately. You can invite again at any time.
speaker.assistantOnlySpeaker: Only the speaker can invite an assistant.
speaker.sessionLead: Submit your content and upload the presentation.
speaker.noSessionBody: Your session appears here as soon as the programme team assigns you to one.
speaker.submitDone: Submitted — the programme team will look at it.
speaker.deadlineUnknown: The deadline is set once your time slot is fixed.
speaker.deadlinePassedHint: the deadline has passed, you can still upload
speaker.uploadHint: PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote, up to 100 MB. A new file replaces the previous one, the old one is kept.
speaker.uploadLate: late, the team has been notified
speaker.uploadTooBig: The file is larger than 100 MB.
speaker.uploadWrongType: Please use PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote.
speaker.downloadFailed: The file could not be opened.
speaker.slidesConsentMissing: Slid@Home still needs your consent in the profile.
speaker.stepContentBody: Title, description and topics of your session — the programme team fills the announcement from it.
speaker.stepPresentationBody: PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote. At the latest 48 hours before you go on stage.
speaker.expenseLead: Record your receipts and release the expense invoice.
speaker.expenseNotCovered: Travel expenses are not part of your appearance. If that looks wrong, write to the speaker team.
speaker.expenseNotApproved: Travel expenses are planned but not finally approved yet. The area lead does that — you will hear from us.
speaker.positionsHint: One line per receipt. Every line needs a photo or PDF of the receipt.
speaker.bankHint: The IBAN is stored encrypted and only ever shown shortened in the portal.
speaker.bankNeedsDraft: Save at least one receipt line first.
speaker.bankAssistant: Only the speaker can enter the bank details.
speaker.submitHint: After releasing, the claim goes to the area lead. You cannot change it afterwards.
speaker.submitAssistant: Only the speaker can release the claim.
speaker.submitBodyDialog: The claim goes to the area lead and cannot be changed afterwards.
speaker.amountHigh: Single amounts above €5,000 are not accepted — please split them.
speaker.receiptFailed: The receipt could not be uploaded.
speaker.receiptWrongType: Please use a PDF or an image.
speaker.rejectedHint: The claim came back. Change it and release it again.
speaker.invoiceFooter: Created in the ChefTreff portal. No VAT shown.
speaker.waitingSubmitted: The claim is with the area lead. You will get an email once it is decided.
speaker.waitingDecided: This claim is closed. You can start a new one when you have expenses again.
speaker.travelLead: Book hotel and shuttle once the team has unlocked it for you.
speaker.arrivalBody:
The Congress Center Hamburg sits at Dammtor, right in the city.
By train: long-distance services stop at Hamburg Dammtor, a five-minute walk away.
By car: there is a car park at the CCH, the approach is signposted. Allow extra time at rush hour.
On site: the speaker counter in the foyer is your first stop.
speaker.notEligibleBody: The speaker team unlocks hotel and shuttle once your appearance is settled. Nothing for you to do — we will get in touch.
speaker.noOptions: There are no quotas set up for you right now.
speaker.waitlistHint: This quota is full. Your request goes on the waiting list and moves up if someone cancels.
speaker.waitlistNote: You are on the waiting list. If a place opens up, you move up.
speaker.cancelBody: Your place is freed and goes to the waiting list. You can book again afterwards.
speaker.declinedBody: Hotel and shuttle are not part of your appearance. If that looks wrong, write to the speaker team.

programme.title: Programme board
programme.lead: Stages as columns, 5-minute grid. Drag to move, the bottom edge changes the duration.
programme.hint: Double-click empty space to create a slot.
programme.confirmMoveBody: This session is already published. The change is immediately public and is recorded in the history.
programme.noEventBody: No event with stages exists for this edition yet. That comes from the migration's seed data.
programme.noDayBody: No days have been set up for this event yet.
programme.confirmHoursHint: Time from release to confirm an offer.
programme.titleRequired: A session cannot be saved without a title (DE).
programme.questionsHint: From the question catalogue. Changes save immediately.

applications.title: Applications
applications.lead: Per session: where the applications stand, decide and release.
applications.emptyBody: A session with access mode “application” appears here as soon as it has applications.
applications.queueEmptyBody: No one has applied for this session so far.
applications.notReleasedHint: Applicants only see their status after the release; the emails go out then as well.
applications.releaseBody: Afterwards every applicant sees their status, accepted ones get a confirmation deadline, and the emails go out. This cannot be undone.
applications.maskedHint: This application was not shared — name, profile and answers stay hidden.
applications.notDecidable: Cannot be changed in this status.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Grant and revoke roles with a scope. Every change is in the audit log.

roles.noRoles: No role recorded for this person yet.
roles.revokeBody: The role ends immediately. The entry stays as history.
roles.assignHint: The same role in the same scope is extended rather than duplicated.
roles.scopeEmpty: Nothing to choose for this scope.
roles.orgSearchHint: Search starts at two characters — name or slug.
